text:
sophia: FYI saw a few tenants get the v1 deprecation nudge despite their tokens routing to v2. Console banner says v1-sunset.

omar: oof. Is that from backfilled tenant flags or runtime mismatch?

sophia: Quick trace: request had X-Client-Version: 2, runtime affinity -> v2, but tenant.feature_flags.deprec_state == 'legacy' in db. Renderer reads DB on mount and doesn't consult runtime.

kelly: So banner = db backfill, routing = live affinity. UX confusion but not user-visible regression. PMs want the banner to be defensive: "If your traffic is on v2 you can ignore this banner" when runtime reports v2.

pm-eli: That copy sounds fine. Also want a small console metric to show how many tenants have banner != runtime for the last 24h.

sophia: technical ask: can renderer query runtime cache for token affinity to decide banner suppression? Might be chatty. Alternative: on banner render, issue a lightweight routing check (internal API) with tenant id and show a synthesized hint.

omar: cheaper: add a join in renderer to read runtime_affinity_realtime table (cached in memstore) keyed by token. We already update that table on every request for diagnostics.

kelly: Also there's billing noise: some of these tenants show split usage in preview (v1 + v2 rows). That usually comes from backfill emitting meters without X-Dedupe-Key.

sophia: I found backfill job backfill-202407 that used emitter v0.9 and didn't set dedupe header. We should re-run a dedupe pass and tag backfill meters with source=backfill.

infra-bot: scheduled job created: METRIC-RECON-554 to run dedupe for backfill-202407.

pm-eli: two asks for eng: (1) banner suppression join (low risk), (2) add "banner_vs_runtime_mismatch" metric (1m/1h) and surface in tenant diagnostics. Also please add a small console tooltip explaining "why you might see this banner if you already migrated".

omar: I'll implement renderer join and add a feature flag so we can pilot for 50 tenants. Will also ensure meter backfill is tagged. Filing ENG-5023 for renderer join, ENG-5024 for backfill reemit/mark.

kelly: QA note: when you pilot, please include tokens that never call the refresh endpoint (long TTL) so we catch anchor anomalies.

sophia: thanks. putting owners on ENG-5023/5024. infra-bot: mark ENG-5023 as in-progress.

infra-bot: ENG-5023 status -> in_progress.
